summary: This plugin adds a separate approval-mode workflow to DeepSeek Harness web sessions, letting users choose how tool requests are reviewed as manual, smart, or unattended.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This repository is best classified as an automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that governs request approval flow. It adds a separate user-facing approval mode control (manual, smart, unattended) and routes action requests through a review policy with bounded context and one-time outcomes, while reusing existing DSH access permissions rather than replacing them. The provided package metadata and files indicate a productionized DSH web plugin with UI and command integration, so the primary purpose is automated approval decision support in tool execution workflows, not development tooling generation.
